title: Planning, Design & Permits

stage.name: Plans and permits
stage.description: A plan on paper and permission to build. Nothing stands yet, but the big decisions are made.

intro: Every house starts as a conversation about what you need.

questions.prompt: What does a building permit confirm?
options: The plans meet local safety and building codes
The house will be finished on time
questions.why: Permits make sure a house is designed to be safe before anyone builds it.

questions.prompt: Put the first steps of building in order.
items: Decide what you need from the house
questions.why: Changes are easiest on paper, so the thinking comes first.

questions.prompt: Changing the plan is cheapest before construction starts.
questions.why: Moving a wall on paper costs an eraser. Moving it later costs a crew.

questions.prompt: Planning a life together starts with…
options: Talking honestly about what each of you wants
Assuming you want the same things
questions.why: Big hopes about family, faith, money and place are easier to talk about early.

talk: Where do you each picture yourselves in five years?
